responsibility: Provides the empty implementation module for IOConsts, whose functional content is the shared ReadResults type defined in the companion definition module. It serves as the implementation placeholder for the common read-status constants used across the ISO channel and text I/O stack.
same_name_distinction: Unlike IOConsts.def, which actually defines the ReadResults enumeration, this .mod file contains no implementation code and exists only as the required empty implementation module for that definition module.
